description_en: Queries the list of users in a cluster
description_zh: 调用ListUsers查询集群用户列表
name: ListUsers

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html to obtain the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Minimum value: 1

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
当前页码。

起始值：1

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示的条数。取值范围：1~50

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list

AddTime.description_en: The time when the user was added. The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss format and does not contain time zone information
AddTime.description_zh: 添加用户的时间。时间格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss，不包含时区信息

Group.description_en:
The user group. Valid values:

users: ordinary permission group. This group is suitable for ordinary users who only need to commit and debug jobs.
wheel: sudo permission group. This group is suitable for administrators who need cluster management. In addition to committing and debugging jobs, administrators can execute sudo commands to install software, restart nodes, and perform other operations
Group.description_zh:
用户组。可能值：

users：普通权限组，适用于只有提交、调试作业需求的普通用户。
wheel：sudo权限组，适用于需要管理集群的管理员，除提交、调试作业外，还可以执行sudo命令进行安装软件、重启节点等操作
